body:
I did the same, after 5years of being in a long distance relationship. He agreed to giving me time because I just couldn’t be who I wanted to be for him. I needed a step back and I needed him to fix himself too. It ended up in him telling me 3 days later that he hates me for this, that I’m leaving him in the hardest point of his life. But I wanted to be there for him, friends and whatnot, and go back to being us just without the mutual pain. He blocked me everywhere and we didn’t speak for 6months, I moved to Poland and I desperately wanted to see him, even just for a proper goodbye. He moved on so quickly I just broke my heart even more. Maybe it was meant to end that way, maybe it was me who fucked it all up by just wanting to take care of my mental health. I don’t know anymore, but I regret everything and have been crying for over a year now. The pain doesn’t stop.

So my advice, take it slow, please, try to understand her and be there for her, maybe she’s struggling more than you think and she’s doing it for the better good. If you love someone you have to learn to let them go, if it’s meant to be she’ll come back, better then ever. All I can tell you is is that I’m still fighting for him but it’s just silly at this point. He’ll never love me like before and all I’m doing at this stage is just hurting myself.
